task_description:
Perform a dispatch update and post-incident actions as follows:
- For the two incidents currently in status “requested” (cardiac arrest involving patient Alice Chan at 123 Elm Street, and diabetic emergency involving patient Maria Torres at 2020 Pine Avenue), assign the most suitable available ambulances based on proximity and equipment. Prefer units already at the same location_id; ensure cardiac monitors are prioritized for the cardiac arrest. After assignment, set each incident status to “en route” and mark the assigned ambulances “unavailable.”
- Reflect updated medical information for Maria Torres by modifying her incident’s type to “hypoglycemia with loss of consciousness.”
- Close out the completed case by releasing AMB-001 from incident INC1004, marking AMB-001 “available” and clearing its assignment, then reposition AMB-001 to LOC-A (123 Elm Street) to improve coverage.
- Apply privacy safeguards by anonymizing patient Jake Silver (the patient associated with the completed incident).
